title: Maison Berger Paris - Perfumed Bouquet Refill 200ml - White Cashmere Perfume
description:
Product Description
Let yourself be charmed by Cachemire Blanc, a sweet perfume of eternity with pure, subtle and fascinating notes.

An infinite, pure and extremely elegant white fragrance.
A cottony atmosphere, the porous white-gray of moonstone, the dull sound of space and the dust of stars, this perfume evokes all of this at once thanks to the delicious white musks. The soft woods give a raw texture, bring comfort, soothe, it is calm, silence and slowness, the constancy of the mechanics of the planets. Its floral heart is a subtle delight. The aqueous notes give a light freshness to the whole.

TOP NOTES: Bergamot, Aquatic notes, Cashemeran
HEART NOTES: Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Ylang-Ylang
BASE NOTES: Patchouli, Sandalwood, White Musks

The enveloping fragrant lightness of this White Cashmere Bouquet Refill 200ml immediately makes the atmosphere pleasant and comfortable. The woody essence of cashhemeran combines with the refined scents of orange blossom and the delicacy of white musk, thus giving this beautiful purity to the fragrance. Other accords enhance it, such as bergamot, jasmine, ylang-ylang or even patchouli and sandalwood, all in voluptuousness. As for the aquatic notes, they provide a little extra freshness that is very appreciable to the perfume. Create a soothing and elegant atmosphere with the White Cashmere Bouquet Refill 200ml, with a heavenly scent. Its polar aura and icy beauty captivate you and offer you, for a moment, real olfactory comfort. Just one of its silky caresses is enough to immediately take you to distant lands. Pour the concentrate into your scented bouquet and let the sticks soak in so you can quickly enjoy it.
